verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only single-item ledger operations (create, MARK, ARCHIVE) and filtered listing. The Ralph loop explicitly executes "exactly one" task. Installing all skills at once or updating all agent copies is package setup, an adjacent feature rather than bulk operations on many items, so nothing documents applying one operation across many ledger items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
